item.title: Legal complaint to restore America’s Cup
item.description: Since John Sweeney fired his warning shot about how the current holder of the America’s Cup was running the event in material violation of the Deed of Gift, he is now walking the walk: On February 12, 2026, I filed a formal legal complaint with the New York Attorney General’s Charities Bureau regarding serious violations of the America’s Cup Deed of Gift, a permanent New York charitable trust. item.description: Greg Kiely is a World Sailing International Umpire and is worried about the direction the sport is headed: At the second event of the 2026 SailGP season, two of their F50s had a dramatic high-speed collision. item.description: The inaugural edition of the New York Yacht Club International Women’s Championship will be held September 12-19, 2026, at the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, RI. item.title: 2026 Women’s World Match Racing Tour
item.description: The 2026 Women’s World Match Racing Tour will visit three continents with events in Denmark, USA, Sweden, Bermuda, and Saudi Arabia. - Details

item.title: Lineup revealed for 2026 Ficker Cup
item.description: The full lineup of eight skippers for the 2026 Ficker Cup has been released, with the international field to race April 24-26 in Long Beach, CA. The Ficker Cup is a Grade 2 match race event on the World Match Racing Tour and serves as a qualifier for the 2026 Congressional Cup. - Full report

item.title: College keelboat racing coming to PNW
item.description: The Storm Trysail Club will be expanding its Intercollegiate Offshore Regatta (IOR) schedule in 2026. Along with the East Coast IOR and Great Lakes IOR will be the addition of the Pacific Coast Intercollegiate Offshore Regatta in the Pacific Northwest. - Details
